properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured) 2026-09-26: Claude Code 2.1.283 rejects the latent surface's tool list — "Invalid result for tools/list: ttlMs … cacheScope" — because latent.rs builds it with ListToolsResult::with_all_items, which omits the two fields the 2026-07-28 spec requires; the full surface's override copies the rule by hand, the latent one never did
properties.source: dev_reflow2 hub session, 2026-09-26, run as the root-cause skill on Anthony's /root-cause: `claude mcp list` with Claude Code 2.1.283, a local stand-in capturing its requests, stdio replay against reflow2-mcp 0.71.0 in three setups, and the rmcp 3.4.0 source
properties.statement:
① OBSERVED (Claude Code 2.1.283, empty folder, machine-wide entry `reflow2-mcp --graph-path .reflow2/graph --shared --only-if-present`, binary 0.71.0): "! Connected · tools fetch failed — Invalid result for tools/list: [ { "expected": "number", "code": "invalid_type", "path": [ "ttlMs" ] … }, { "code": "invalid_value", "values": [ "public", "private" ], "path": [ "cacheScope" ] … } ]". Expected: the latent surface's two tools listed, so /genesis can start a design. First seen 2026-09-26 ~21:05 UTC; the user's Claude Code moved 2.1.282 → 2.1.283 that afternoon. NOT affected: the same binary's full surface (child-flo2, child-reflow2 in the hub) lists 193 tools in the same Claude Code.

② PRECEDENT: none (search on the raw error).

③ CANDIDATES: C1 the latent surface builds its reply differently and omits/malforms the fields; C2 rmcp serialises them wrongly everywhere; C3 Claude Code is stricter than the spec (outside reflow2); C4 the two surfaces negotiate different protocol versions; C5 the observation is of the wrong process.

⑤ MEASURED: Claude Code 2.1.283 first sends `server/discover` with `_meta["io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion"] = "2026-07-28"`, falling back to `initialize` 2025-11-25. Replaying that exactly over stdio: (a) latent — server/discover answered; tools/list 2 tools, ttlMs ABSENT, cacheScope ABSENT; (b) full surface — 193 tools, ttlMs 0, cacheScope "public"; degraded surface (a file where the graph dir should be) — 1 tool, ttlMs 0, cacheScope "public". C5 refuted (the latent surface of 0.71.0 answered). C2 refuted (the full and degraded surfaces carry both). C4 refuted as the cause (both negotiate 2026-07-28; the fields differ). C3 refuted: rmcp 3.4.0's model says both are "Required by spec version 2026-07-28", optional in the type only for older peers. C1 CONFIRMED: latent.rs:396 `ListToolsResult::with_all_items(self.tool_router.list_all())` leaves both None; service.rs:6616's override sets them for >= 2026-07-28 by hand (its comment: "mirrors the macro's generated one — cache hints included", added in #492, 2026-09-12).

⑥ CLASS: reflow2 overrides rmcp's generated listing to add behaviour, and each override must re-create the library's protocol-version-dependent fields by hand, with nothing checking it. Exactly two overrides exist (service.rs, latent.rs); one copied the rule, one did not; it stayed hidden until the first client to speak 2026-07-28. Proposed (awaiting Anthony): one shared builder both overrides call, owning the version rule; pinned by a test that sends every surface (full, latent, degraded) the 2026-07-28 and 2025-11-25 handshakes and requires the fields exactly under the newer one — failing today on latent.

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: whether Grok Build (grok-cli 1.0.41, also seen sending server/discover to api.flo2.io) hits the same failure on the latent surface — likely, untested; what rmcp 3.4.1 changes here — its changelog not yet read; the separate `--shared` observation (server/discover through the proxy answered −32000) is recorded on its own and not explained here.
